purpose: Document official local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Land Authority documentation describes historic cadastral-map processing and a Gaza-wide parcel GIS database, and separately identifies survey/registration activity by the Khan Yunis office. No anonymous parcel feature API, viewer schema or exact-point geometry response was found. Older agency pages describe capabilities but do not prove current service uptime or current WUP-point coverage.
registryAssessment: The Palestinian Land Authority describes a Gaza-wide land-information system based on cadastral maps and a geographic database of more than 30,000 parcels, linked to a central GIS server; it also documents a Khan Yunis office and land-registry/survey activity. This confirms local land administration, not anonymous current geometry for the exact WUP point.
